title: Slovakian Eggplant Casserole
description: A hearty Slovakian-inspired eggplant casserole with a rich and flavorful taste. This dish is perfect for a comforting dinner.
instructions: 2. Slice the eggplant into 1/4-inch thick rounds.
3. In a shallow dish, mix together the breadcrumbs and Slovakian paprika.
4. Dip each eggplant slice into the breadcrumb mixture, coating both sides evenly.
5. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
6. Add the eggplant slices to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
7. In a separate skillet, sauté the garlic until fragrant.
8. In a large bowl, combine the cooked eggplant, garlic, and kissed ricotta cheese.
9. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
10. Transfer the eggplant mixture to a 9x13-inch baking dish.
11. Top with additional breadcrumbs if desired.
12. Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the casserole is hot and the breadcrumbs are golden brown.
